verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter is an immigration law firm offering attorney-led legal services. Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a software-product axis, not a fair comparison question for legal representation. Its secure client portal (docs-10) is incidental, and nothing in the evidence describes product telemetry that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
